Remark
[Exterior derivative in covariant form] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0297 1. Section A.3\group first-order-differential-operators-on-forms

Although independent of the metric, the exterior derivative may be written in terms of the Levi-Civita covariant derivative as \[ d\theta (Y_0,\ldots ,Y_p)=\sum _{i=0}^p (-1)^i (\nabla _{Y_i}\theta )(Y_0,\ldots ,\widehat{Y_i},\ldots ,Y_p). \]
